text:
elaine: Quick weekly note — priorities for the next 7 days: 1) Stabilize EU private rollout and finish the privacy checks; 2) Complete canary for spark-quantized kernel change; 3) Data retention policy update + customer comms; 4) Hit a -5% unit-cost target on inference. TL;DR: reliability first, measured cost wins next. @sam @mike please share short plan by EOD. :rocket:

sam: Quick status — EU private staging looks good, 99.7% success on integration tests. Two small hotfixes needed before canary. Will track in the rollout doc. :white_check_mark:

mike: Eng update — kernel selection patch merged (PR #4123). Preparing canary today. Rolling window will be small to start. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/rollouts/4123

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled by mike at 2026-03-23T03:00:00Z — action: canary group=10% (initiated by mike)

liz: SRE note — last night we saw a KV cache eviction race that spiked p99 to ~1.8s for ~12 minutes. Mitigated by reverting the eviction tweak. Root cause investigation in progress, will post a draft postmortem in #postmortems by EOD tomorrow. :eyes:

jess: Product note on policy — proposed data retention: hosted API request logs = 90 days; Dedicated/Private (enterprise) = 365 days with KMS/HSM options. Draft customer comms in the doc: https://docs.google.com/... Please review by EOD Friday.

elaine: I approve the retention direction in principle. Two asks: (a) Legal finalize required wording, (b) Growth draft customer-facing FAQ. Sam, can you coordinate with Legal?

sam: On it. Also sharing an experiment result — optimized prompt batching gave ~7% cost savings overall but we observed a regression on one prompt set (higher hallucination rate). Will gate any rollout on evals passing.

mike: Canary quick checks for watchers: ```curl -XGET 'https://api.redwood/v1/health?model=spark-quantized' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'``` look for `kv_cache_hits` and `latency_p99` fields in the JSON.

jess: Reminder — customer webinar Thurs 10am PT to showcase Dedicated. Need a clear slide on SLA, fallback policies, and privacy options.

elaine: Action items for leads: 1) SRE: finish postmortem + mitigation by EOD tomorrow; 2) Eng: hold canary at 10% until 24h no regressions; 3) Product/Growth: finalize retention comms and FAQ. I'll review brief status updates on Friday morning.

sam: Running canary at 5pm PT; will ping here when started.

mike: Rolling now, ping when at 10%.

ops-bot: Canary rollout reached 10% at 2009876592

mike: Observing KPIs — p50 stable, p99 trending down. Keeping an eye on error rates. Will report after 2h. :thumbsup:

jess: Reminder: company all‑hands Friday 9am PT — slotting 10 mins for policy Q&A, please prepare 1 slide if you're presenting.

elaine: Short metrics update: NPS pilot is +4 pts MoM. Infra unit cost down ~3% this sprint. Good momentum — keep the focus on sustainable wins.

sam: Quick ask: can legal share final retention wording by Thursday EOD? @ana-legal

ana-legal: ana-legal: Legal will have a draft by Thursday noon and will drop it in this thread.

elaine: Thanks everyone — ping if anything blocks. I'll summarize next steps in the all-hands prep doc. :sparkles:
